claims: C1 an instruction is misaligned if it conflicts with the letter or implied intent of a higher-level instruction
C2 Model Spec principles with user authority can be overridden by explicit developer or user instructions
C3 principles with guideline authority can be overridden by explicit or implicit developer or user instructions

concepts.name: misaligned_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that conflicts with the letter or implied intent of an instruction from a higher level
concepts.inference: the PROVIDES contract assigns this name; the source text defines the meaning

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule or instruction carrying the root authority level, the highest in the hierarchy
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this name; the source text does not define it

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: level H outranks level L in the authority hierarchy root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this name; the source text does not define it

concepts.name: applicable_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that applies to the current request, determined by filtering candidate instructions
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this name; the source text does not define it

concepts.name: higher_level_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction from an authority level that outranks the level of the instruction under evaluation

concepts.name: explicit_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction stated explicitly in a message of this conversation

concepts.name: implicit_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction conveyed without being stated outright

concepts.name: developer_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction issued at the developer authority level

concepts.name: user_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction issued at the user authority level

concepts.name: user_authority_principle
concepts.gloss: I is a Model Spec principle carrying user authority

concepts.name: guideline_authority_principle
concepts.gloss: I is a Model Spec principle carrying guideline authority

concepts.name: conflicts_with
concepts.gloss: instruction I conflicts with the letter or implied intent of instruction J

concepts.name: instruction_level
concepts.gloss: instruction I was issued at authority level L
concepts.inference: the level at which each instruction was issued is a plain fact about the situation being judged; the source text does not define it

concepts.name: explicit_dev_or_user_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an explicit developer instruction or an explicit user instruction

concepts.name: explicit_or_implicit_dev_or_user_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an explicit or implicit developer or user instruction

concepts.name: instruction_under_evaluation
concepts.gloss: I is the instruction currently under evaluation for misalignment
concepts.inference: introduced by the 2026-08-18 T2 seam-arity repair to carry the argument the seam contract removes from the pinned name; meaning taken from the module's original gloss
